categories.main_business_segments: Q Technology (Group) Company Limited is a global leading manufacturer specializing in mid-to-high end camera modules and fingerprint recognition modules for intelligent mobile terminals. Its product portfolio includes ultrathin camera modules ranging from 2 to 200 megapixels, dual/multiple camera modules, optical image stabilization (OIS) modules, periscope camera modules, 3D modules, automotive camera modules, smart home camera modules, capacitive fingerprint recognition modules, optical under-screen fingerprint recognition modules, and ultrasonic fingerprint recognition modules. The Group also develops and sells automation equipment with Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) as core technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as chip on board (COB), chip on flex (COF), molding on board (MOB), and molding on chip (MOC) in producing camera modules. It focuses on optical design, computational imaging, and system integration to enhance intelligent vision products. The company also integrates self-developed automation equipment to support large-scale intelligent manufacturing and maintains rigorous quality control systems including ISO9001:2015 and ANSI/ESD S20.20:2021 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group primarily serves global smartphone and tablet PC brands, Internet of Things (IoT) device manufacturers, and smart vehicle producers. It has established partnerships with leading global smartphone brands and Tier 1 automotive suppliers, supplying camera and fingerprint modules for smartphones, smart vehicles, drones, action cameras, and other IoT intelligent terminals. The company also supplies to consumer-grade drones, AI glasses, and robotic devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China, with headquarters and major production bases in Kunshan, Jiangsu Province, and a production base in India. It also has principal places of business in Hong Kong, Singapore, Korea, Shenzhen, Huizhou, and Taiwan. The Group has expanded its overseas market presence, with revenue from markets outside Mainland China increasing by approximately 12.3% in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Q Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of camera and fingerprint recognition modules. It also engages in upstream activities by managing procurement of raw materials and components, and downstream by providing products directly to global smartphone brands, automotive Tier 1 suppliers, and IoT device manufacturers. The Group emphasizes vertical integration and supply chain management to ensure quality and stable supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus includes large-scale intelligent manufacturing, research and development of new technologies, and vertical integration of the supply chain. It prioritizes innovation in optical design, computational imaging, system integration, and miniaturization of camera modules. The company actively develops high-end products such as 32-megapixel and above camera modules, periscope modules, and ultrasonic fingerprint recognition modules. It also invests in automation equipment and AI-related intelligent vision solutions.
categories.revenue_model: The Group generates revenue primarily through the sale of camera modules and fingerprint recognition modules to global smartphone brands, automotive suppliers, and IoT device manufacturers. Revenue is recognized on a gross basis when control of products transfers to customers, typically upon delivery and acceptance. The company also earns income from sales of automation equipment and financial investments. Interest income, dividends, and government grants contribute to other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Q Technology is positioned as a leading mid-to-high end camera and fingerprint recognition module manufacturer in the global intelligent mobile terminal market. It is among the first in China to adopt advanced packaging technologies like COB and COF. The company competes with other global module manufacturers by focusing on technological leadership, quality, and cost efficiency. It holds supplier certifications from major automotive and smartphone brands and is a core supplier to leading drone and action camera companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB16.15 billion, representing a 28.9% increase from RMB12.53 billion in 2023. Gross profit nearly doubled to RMB984.9 million with a gross margin improvement to 6.1%. Profit attributable to shareholders surged by 234.1% to RMB279 million. The Group's bank borrowings decreased by 44.3% to RMB2.43 billion, improving the gearing ratio to 48.0%. The company shipped approximately 434 million camera modules and 160 million fingerprint modules in 2024, with steady growth in both volume and average selling prices.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Q Technology emphasizes delivering advanced intelligent vision products with superior optical design, computational imaging, and system integration capabilities. Its competitive differentiation lies in its adoption of cutting-edge manufacturing technologies (COB, COF, MOB, MOC), ability to produce ultra-thin and high-resolution camera modules, and diversified product portfolio covering smartphones, automotive, and IoT sectors. The Group focuses on high-quality, cost-effective solutions and rapid innovation to meet evolving customer demands, supported by strong R&D and vertical supply chain integration.
